name: r6-mut-lifecycle-collation
description: Mutation triage (inventory pass, zone-schedule/lifecycle-snapshot-order; nul-char nul-lead on valve_schedules.schedule_uuid in r5-conn-lifecycle-case): push.js lifecycleBindingTx sorts the retired and live schedule lists with String.prototype.localeCompare (ICU root collation): U+0000 is ignorable, punctuation sorts before digits and digits before letters, '10' before '9'. Go sorted with SQLite COLLATE NOCASE, so the managed pause stored conditional_control_json with the lists in another order.

steps.why: Review fixture data for the paired parity probe.
